item.title: How to Size Solar Power for a Remote Sensor
item.description: A remote sensor needs enough stored energy to keep reporting through dark days, and enough panel output to refill that reserve. Here is a practical way to work through both sides.

item.title: How to Get a Custom 3D-Printed Part That Actually Fits
item.description: A replacement clip, a mount for a camera, an adapter between two things that were never meant to connect. Here is what decides whether a printed part fits the first time, and why the second print is usually the one you keep.
